entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The State Of Maharashtra

... 
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Gaware Niteen V.
 App for Respondent : Mr. S D Ghayal

... 
 Coram : V.K. Jadhav, J.
Dated: October 04, 2019 ...

Per Court :-
1.
Heard.

2. After going through the investigation papers, though I find no connecting evidence against the applicant, however, matter is under investigation and the Investigating Officer needs some time to find out the connection between co-accused and the present applicant.
Apart from the same, co-accused has disclosed name of the person from whom he had purchased contraband as Shoheb Ansari r/o Yeola.
present Applicant is SHOHEB KHAN ISMAIL KHAN.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that it is a aaa/-
2 ABA 1219.2019.odt case of mistaken identity and the Investigating Officer is unnecessarily behind the applicant in connection with the present crime.
In view of the above, the applicant needs to be protected by an interim order of anticipatory bail with certain conditions.
His antecedents are clear.

Hence, untill further orders, in the event of arrest of the applicant SHOHEB KHAN ISMAIL KHAN in connection with crime No. 238 of 2019 registered with Vaijapur Police Station, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273, 188, 328 r/w 34 of IPC and under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he be released on bail on his furnishing Shoheb Khan Ismail Khan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 4 October, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70154247/
